story: As a pilot customer, I want the order-status page to show the carrier tracking link so that I can follow my delivery without calling support
acceptance_criteria: Given a shipped order, when I open its status page, then the carrier name and a working tracking link are shown

story: As a customer, I want knowledge-base search to tolerate typos so that I still find the right article
acceptance_criteria: Given the misspelled query pasword reset, when I search, then the password-reset article is in the top three results

story: As a customer, I want to sign in once with my existing account through the identity provider (single sign-on) so that I do not manage another password
acceptance_criteria: Given an identity-provider account, when I choose Sign in with SSO, then my dashboard loads within 3 seconds and a failed provider response shows a retry message. Not ready until the vendor production tenant is live (R001)

story: As a keyboard-only user, I want every self-service journey to be operable without a mouse so that I can complete it unaided (CR003)
acceptance_criteria: Given any reset or order-status page, when I navigate by keyboard only, then every control is reachable with a visible focus indicator and the WCAG 2.2 AA audit passes

story: As a screen-reader user, I want form errors announced so that I can correct them (CR003)
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid entry on the reset form, when I submit, then the error is announced and focus moves to the field in error

story: As the QA engineer, I want automated regression tests for the reset and order-status journeys so that every release is verified in under 30 minutes
acceptance_criteria: Given a release candidate, when the pipeline runs, then both journeys are tested end to end in under 30 minutes

story: As a customer, I want a clear message when an order number is not found so that I do not raise a ticket
acceptance_criteria: Given an unknown order number, when I search, then I see what to check and a link to contact support

story: As the head of support operations, I want a weekly deflection report by ticket type so that I can track the 50% reduction target
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed week, when the report runs, then password-reset and order-status ticket volumes are shown against the 3-month pre-launch baseline

story: As the operations team, we want the portal load-tested at the forecast launch peak so that launch traffic does not degrade it
acceptance_criteria: Given the forecast peak load for 30 minutes, when the load test runs, then 95% of pages load within 2 seconds and the error rate stays below 0.1%

story: As the security lead, I want every high-rated penetration-test finding fixed so that I can sign off the release
acceptance_criteria: Given the penetration-test report, when the fixes are deployed, then a retest shows no open high or critical findings

story: As the service desk, we want a runbook and alerting for the portal so that incidents are handled after handover
acceptance_criteria: Given a simulated outage, when the alert fires, then the on-call analyst restores service by following the runbook

story: As a pilot customer, I want order status to refresh when the shipment updates so that I always see current information
acceptance_criteria: Given a carrier status change, when I reopen the order page 15 minutes later, then the new status is shown

story: As a customer, I want to rate a knowledge-base article so that poor articles get improved
acceptance_criteria: Given an article, when I choose helpful or not helpful, then the vote is recorded and shown in the editor view

story: As a customer, I want suggested articles while I type my question so that I find the answer before raising a ticket
acceptance_criteria: Given the contact form, when I type at least three words, then up to five matching articles appear (opportunity R006)

story: As a finance analyst, I want to export the deflection report to CSV so that I can reconcile ticket-handling costs
acceptance_criteria: Given the weekly report, when I choose Export, then a CSV with the same figures downloads

story: As a customer, I want to see my last five orders on the dashboard so that I do not need the order number
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in customer with orders, when the dashboard loads, then the five most recent orders and their status are listed

story: As a knowledge-base editor, I want to schedule article publication so that articles go live with the release
acceptance_criteria: Given a draft article with a publish date, when the date arrives, then the article becomes visible without manual action

story: As a customer, I want the portal to follow my device dark-mode setting so that it is comfortable to read
acceptance_criteria: Given dark mode on my device, when I open the portal, then the dark theme is applied and still meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast

story: As the head of support operations, I want a weekly deflection trend chart so that I can show progress to the steering committee
acceptance_criteria: Given at least four weeks of data, when I open the report, then a weekly trend per ticket type is shown

story: As a customer, I want to save articles to a favourites list so that I can find them again
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in customer, when I save an article, then it appears under My articles

story: As a customer, I want an order-status link by text message so that I can check delivery from my phone
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile number on file, when my order ships, then I receive a text with a link to its status page

story: As a customer, I want a push notification when my order ships so that I do not have to check the portal
acceptance_criteria: Not yet written

story: As a customer, I want a live-chat widget so that I can talk to an agent from the portal
acceptance_criteria: Deferred to phase 2 by CR001
